in_marathi.name: Aryashree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Noble, Pure, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arya means 'noble' or 'pure' in Sanskrit. Shree means 'radiant' or 'prosperous'. Together, Aryashree represents a noble and radiant being. In Hindu mythology, Aryashree is a name given to the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, learning, and art.

Together, Aryashree represents a noble and radiant being. In Hindu mythology, Aryashree is a name given to the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, learning, and art.
